balance.label: Cash & equivalents (some periods incl. restricted cash)

warnings: core facts filed in CAD — figures are shown as filed (no FX conversion)
interest expense: the row mixes gross and NET figures, so it keeps the label "Interest expense"; net (income inside) for 5 period(s) 2010-12-31..2021-12-31

other non-operating: NonoperatingIncomeExpense is the filer's whole non-operating section (interest included) for some periods; blank for 3 period(s) (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2018-12-31) where neither reading reconciles to pretax income

restricted cash: in 3 period(s), 2015-12-31..2019-12-31 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 3 period(s), 2015-12-31..2019-12-31 the restricted part is the restricted-cash figure filed for the same date (RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents, RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue); that part is shown on the 'Restricted cash (included in cash above)' line and deducted from cash wherever net cash, net cash per share and the ROIC proxy's invested capital are computed

growth across filing generations: 23 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): aoci (2017-12-31); capex (2016-12-31); change_inventory (2018-12-31, 2019-12-31); change_payables (2019-12-31); da (2018-12-31); deferred_tax_liab (2017-12-31); ebitda (2017-12-31, 2018-12-31); fcf (2016-12-31); fcf_per_share (2016-12-31); long_term_lease (2021-12-31); net_change_cash (2016-12-31); net_income (2016-12-31); ...
